Parts.Description: Sun-baked desert dust over the whole town with wooden boardwalks in front of the buildings.
Parts.Name: Dusty Main Street

Parts.Description: Two floors of weathered planks with swinging doors, a balcony and a tall false front. The Cowboy Shiba guards the porch.
Parts.Name: Rusty Spur Saloon

Parts.Description: A tall log gate over the entrance with a hanging BONK TOWN sign and a longhorn skull on top.
Parts.Name: Bonk Town Gate

Parts.Description: A plank office with a stone jail cell on the side, a tin star and a JAIL board.
Parts.Name: Sheriff's Office

Parts.Description: Two saddle horses, one brown and one white, tied up at a rail with a water trough.
Parts.Name: Hitching Rail

Parts.Description: A round stone well with a little shingle roof, a crank and a wooden bucket.
Parts.Name: Town Well

Parts.Description: A canvas-topped prairie wagon with big wooden wheels, a driver's seat and a pair of barrels.
Parts.Name: Covered Wagon

Parts.Description: A sandstone bank with four columns, a golden vault door and a BANK sign over the portico.
Parts.Name: Gold Bank

Parts.Description: Two tall saguaros with raised arms, round barrel cacti and a few sun-warmed rocks.
Parts.Name: Cactus Garden

Parts.Description: A tall wooden water tank on four legs with braces, a ladder and a pointed roof.
Parts.Name: Water Tower

Parts.Description: A steel lattice windmill with a big blade wheel and tail vane, pumping water into a trough.
Parts.Name: Wind Pump

Parts.Description: A rocky hillside with a timber-framed mine shaft, an ore cart on rails and a pile of gold nuggets.
Parts.Name: Gold Mine

Parts.Description: A black steam engine with a tall funnel, a coal tender and a red freight car on a track along the town edge.
Parts.Name: Steam Locomotive

Parts.Description: A teepee, a crackling campfire between log seats, a crate of supplies and a rolled-up bed.
Parts.Name: Cowboy Camp

Parts.Description: A huge layered red-rock butte with a giant cowboy hat balanced on its flat top.
Parts.Name: Red Rock Mesa
